en: Colorized historic postcard view of a lawn‑tennis court beside a high stone fortification wall. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on and around the court. In the background, beyond trees and bushes, rises a church with two tall spires. Flowerbeds occupy the foreground. The top left corner bears the caption "Reval" and the top right reads "Lawn-Tennisplatz und Karls-Kirche."
